evidence.quote: Our tech partnership team will review your app to make sure it works properly and is aligned with our expectations.

buildability.main_blocker.why: Review applies only to publishing a public App Store listing; private apps use API key and trial accounts are self-serve, so credentials are not gated.

rationale: App review is needed only to list a public app; API-key private apps on a free trial need no approval, so no blocker for integration.
